title.en: Where Our Hearts Will Take Us

texts.zh:
我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。

越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
texts.en:
Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track those who may stray too far. Not everyone is happy with this change.

An increasing number of people have been tampering with their implants, dropping themselves off the grid to preserve their privacy. For now it's a niche trend, but it could create trouble.
